text: When he could not prevail, and Demosthenes's opinion carried it, advising them to make war as far off from home as possible, and fight the battle out of Attica, "Good friend," said Phocion, "let us not ask where we shall fight, but how we may conquer in the war. That will be the way to keep it at a distance. If we are beaten, it will be quickly at our doors."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Phocion
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
